name: Kane Verify on Save
description: Fires Kane CLI against the ProofReel web UI on every save. On failure, Kiro reads the trace and fixes the code. On pass, the recorder renders the green run.

then.prompt: A file in the web-ui was saved. Run Kane CLI to verify the ProofReel web UI is working correctly by testing its primary flow (create a job, see it complete). If Kane fails, read the trace output and fix the broken code. If Kane passes, note that the verified flow is ready for recording.
